context: 1448.1 points got scored across the league this week, 120.67 per team -- make of that what you will.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: Big Dumb Sports's bench outscored their good sense: 51.8 points left sitting, 23.0 of it from Kyle Pitts alone.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: Newman’s Owen scored just 106.52 -- the 9th-highest score in the league this week -- but Supernova Takeover somehow scored even less (102.46), so the win counts all the same.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: Chig-a-Doodle-Doo's defense (well, their opponent's offense) did the work: ROK Navy's Finest finished with just 84.72.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: The week's biggest mismatch: theMadgician over Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000, 127.2-90.5 (36.7 points).
